name: Bueña (Spain)
description: A red hoist stripe with a dancetty edge bearing a yellow castle, the fly yellow with a horizontal band of white and green wavy stripes and a red stripe.
history: By decree 29/1998 of 10 February the Government of Aragon authorised the town council of Bueña, in the province of Teruel, to adopt its municipal arms and flag; the arms are gules, a mountain argent with a winding path vert leading to a castle or with a flag bearing the Royal Sign of Aragon.

features.role: band of white wavy stripes edged green with a red stripe across the fly
